data.name: Dhananjoy
data.long_meaning: Dhananjoy is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘dhan’ meaning wealth or prosperity, and ‘anand’ meaning joy. The name is believed to bring happiness and prosperity to the one who bears it. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with the god Dhanvantari, who is the preserver of Ayurvedic medicine and the giver of health and wealth.
